description:
Manages PubNub keysets with operations: get, list, create, update.
      - 'get': Get a specific keyset information, including its current config (message persistence, App Context, files, presence including presence rules, etc.). User needs to provide the keyset id.
      - 'list': List all keysets for your account or a specific app.
      - 'create': Create a new keyset. New keyset is created with Message Persistence, App Context, Files, and Presence enabled by default;
        the user must provide name, production, and config with nested objects (messagePersistence, appContext, files, presence),
        and if any required parameter is missing, you must ask the user to provide it.
      - 'update': Update an existing keyset. User needs to provide the keyset id and the config to update. Only provided fields are changed.
        presence.rules replaces the stored rules entirely: before changing rules, call 'get' and send the full list including the existing rules to keep.
        If 'get' returns presence.rules as "UNREADABLE", the existing rules cannot be read back; tell the user that sending rules will overwrite them and ask before proceeding.

appId.description: App ID to list keysets for. If not provided, keysets for the entire account will be listed.
App ID. If not provided, a new app will be created. You must ask the user if they want to create a new app.

appContext.description: App Context (Objects) configuration for persisting user and channel metadata.

channelMetadataEvents.description: Enable or disable channel metadata events, which are triggered when channel metadata is set or removed in the objects database. Apps can subscribe and update UI based on channel property changes.

disallowGetAllChannelMetadata.description: If enabled, the "Get All Channel Metadata" call is disallowed. If you enable Access Manager and leave this unchecked, you can get all channel metadata without listing it in the token's permission schema.

disallowGetAllUserMetadata.description: If enabled, the "Get All User Metadata" call is disallowed. If you enable Access Manager and leave this unchecked, you can get all user metadata without listing it in the token's permission schema.

enabled.description: Enable or disable App Context (Objects). Allows persisting user and channel metadata.

membershipEvents.description: Enables or disables membership (associations between users and channels) events, which are triggered when memberships are added, updated or removed in the objects database. This helps you manage and respond to who belongs to which channels. Subscribe to receive and handle these events.

referentialIntegrity.description: When enabled: you can create a membership only if the specified user ID and channel ID exist as standalone metadata entities. Deleting a user or channel automatically deletes its child membership associations. When disabled: you can create memberships even if the user or channel entity doesn't exist. Deleting a user or channel doesn't delete associated memberships.

region.description: Region for App Context storage. Required when enabled=true. Cannot be changed once set.

userMetadataEvents.description: Enable or disable user metadata events, which are triggered when user metadata is set or removed in the objects database.

files.description: File sharing configuration for uploading and sharing files.

enabled.description: Enable or disable file sharing. Allows uploading and sharing files up to 5MB.

region.description: Region for file storage. Required when enabled=true. Cannot be changed once set.

retention.description: Number of days to retain files. Required when enabled=true.

messagePersistence.description: Message persistence configuration for storing and retrieving historical messages.

deleteFromHistory.description: A setting that lets you use API calls to delete specific messages previously stored in a channel's message history.

enabled.description: Enable or disable message persistence. Allows storing and retrieving historical messages.

includePresenceEvents.description: Store presence event messages in message history.

retention.description: Number of days to retain messages. Required when enabled=true.

presence.description: Presence configuration for real-time subscriber information.

activeNoticeChannel.description: Sends notifications when a channel switches between active (has subscribers) and inactive (no subscribers).

announceMax.description: Maximum number of occupants in a channel before announcements switch to emitting occupancy counts instead of emitting "join", "leave" and "timeout" events.

debounce.description: The number of seconds to wait before allowing implicit "joins" after an explicit "leave". Helps smooth out rapid state changes.

deltas.description: If enabled, adds two fields to interval event: a list of UUIDs that have joined and left the channel since the last presence interval message.

enableLegacySDKTracking.description: Whether Presence also counts subscribe requests as liveness, on top of heartbeat requests, for every tracked rule. Defaults to false (heartbeat-only). Enable only when clients rely on subscribe requests to stay present - older SDKs without Event Engine, or SDKs configured with heartbeatInterval: 0. Setting it to true when no rule is tracked fails.

enabled.description: Enable or disable presence. Provides visibility into who is currently subscribed to channels.

generateLeaveOnDisconnect.description: Triggers a "leave" event at the closing of the clients connection (for example, when a browser tab closes or an app is force quit). Generates additional billable events.

interval.description: Cadence in seconds between each announcement of the channel occupancy. Must be greater than or equal to 10

rules.description: Ordered list of rules controlling which channels Presence tracks and which events it publishes. Rules are evaluated in order and the first rule matching a channel wins. A channel matching no rule is not tracked, so a rule that disables specific channels usually needs a following catch-all rule ({ "pattern": "*", "tracking": { "enabled": true, "publishEvents": ["join", "leave", "timeout"] } }). To track nothing send [{ "pattern": "*", "tracking": { "enabled": false } }]. The list replaces the stored rules entirely - to add a rule, include all existing rules you want to keep. Omit the field to leave the current rules unchanged.

pattern.description: Channel pattern. "*" is a wildcard matching one or more characters; every other character is matched literally. Regular expressions are not supported.

tracking.description: Whether Presence tracks channels matching this rule. Tracking is needed for occupancy, publishing events, hereNow/whereNow and Events & Actions ingestion.

publishEvents.description: Presence events published to the `-pnpres` channel. Events left out are not published. An empty list keeps the channel tracked but silent (occupancy, hereNow and whereNow still work).

streamFiltering.description: Once enabled, filters presence events at the client. You receive only relevant events on the Presence channel (for example, join events for a specific User ID).

type.description: Keyset type: 'testing' for testing/development or 'production' for live environments.

operation.description: Operation to perform: 'get' to get specific keyset information, 'list' to list keysets, 'create' to create a new keyset, 'update' to update an existing keyset.
